spanish: Y si no se redimiere hasta llenarse a él año íntegro, y se levantará la casa que en la ciudad que muralla a perpetuidad al comprante a ella, a sus generaciones; no saldrá en el yovel.

findings.issue: Common noun (H3104, Ncmsa) left as the untranslated Hebrew form yovel.
Object suffix is 3ms; ella is feminine and can resume ciudad or muralla as well as casa.
Qal infinitive construct is rendered with reflexive se, which the qal stem does not mark.
Qal perfect 3ms is rendered as a reflexive future; se is not in the qal, and the future resolves the perfect.
Preposition plus definite article plus noun is smoothed to a perpetuidad without the article.

notes: Both relatives, the verbless wall noun, and the other clause roles stay inside the tokens.
